class.name: CgameShaderWarmup
class.brief_description: Precompiles spatial shader pipelines by drawing each shader once off-screen.
class.description: [CgameShaderWarmup] is a short-lived rig attached to a [Camera3D]. For every spatial shader it creates a sub-pixel quad in front of the camera that casts shadows, so the driver compiles the color and shadow pipelines during loading rather than mid-fight. The rig frees itself after [constant FRAMES_VISIBLE] process frames. Shaders are discovered by scanning directories for [code].gdshader[/code] files (default [code]res://assets/shaders[/code] and [code]res://shaders[/code]); only [constant Shader.MODE_SPATIAL] shaders are used. Nothing is drawn on the headless display server. Use [method get_pipeline_compile_counters] before and after the warm-up to see how many pipelines were compiled. [codeblock] var before := CgameShaderWarmup.get_pipeline_compile_total() CgameShaderWarmup.start($Camera3D) await get_tree().create_timer(0.2).timeout print("compiled ", CgameShaderWarmup.get_pipeline_compile_total() - before) [/codeblock]

method.name: default_shader_dirs
method.description: Returns the directories scanned when no directories are given.

method.name: get_frames_left
method.description: Returns the number of process frames before the rig frees itself.

method.name: get_pipeline_compile_counters
method.description: Returns the pipeline compilation counters reported by the [RenderingServer] as a dictionary with the integer keys [code]canvas[/code], [code]mesh[/code], [code]surface[/code], [code]draw[/code], [code]specialization[/code] and [code]total[/code] (the sum of the others).

method.name: shader_paths
method.description: Returns the sorted resource paths of all [code].gdshader[/code] files in [param dirs] (or [method default_shader_dirs] when empty). A [code].remap[/code] suffix of exported resources is ignored. Missing directories are skipped.

method.name: spatial_shaders
method.description: Loads the shaders from [method shader_paths] and returns the spatial ones.

method.name: start
method.description: Attaches a warm-up rig for every spatial shader found in [param dirs] to [param camera] and returns it. Returns [code]null[/code] when [param camera] is [code]null[/code] or the display server is headless.

method.name: start_with_shaders
method.description: Same as [method start] for an explicit shader list. Non-spatial shaders are skipped. Works on every display server.

constants.constant: Number of process frames the rig stays in the scene.
